answer: Every claim climbs the island of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the meadow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on quadratic conviction weighting that decays rapidly under synchronized voting patterns. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the ledge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a mathematical clarity, compound sentences linking proof generation to verification register, it stays short.
